thread.title: Technology Sector Update for 11/06/2018: JCOM, VMW, MSFT, AAPL, IBM, CSCO, GOOG

author: MT Newswires
title: Technology Sector Update for 11/06/2018: JCOM, VMW, MSFT, AAPL, IBM, CSCO, GOOG
text:
Shutterstock photo Top Technology Stocks:
MSFT: Flat
AAPL: -0.48%
IBM: +0.49%
CSCO: Flat
GOOG: Flat
Technology stocks were mostly lower pre-bell Tuesday.
In other sector news:
(=) j2 Global ( JCOM ) was flat as it booked a Q3 adjusted non-GAAP earnings increase to $1.53 per diluted share, topping last year's $1.34 and the $1.51 average Street estimate.
(=) VMWare ( VMW ) was flat after it said that it sealed an agreement to acquire Heptio, a company that helps simplify and scale the open Kubernetes ecosystem for developers and operators.
